title: Representation-Aligned Auxiliary Supervision for Language Model Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.04098v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet adapting them to structured domains remains challenging and can yield inconsistent outcomes. We identify representation compatibility, the extent to which a model effectively processes a representation for a structured task, as a key factor in adaptation. We study this in chess, which provides a controlled testbed with precise semantics, computable optimal actions, and multiple state representations, including a symbolic encoding (FEN) and a spatial format (ASCII). We find that models often process semantically equivalent inputs substantially differently, affecting both learning and generalization. Building on this observation, we propose representation-aligned auxiliary supervision, which uses environment-derived tasks expressed in compatible representations to improve adaptation to structured domains. translated_title: 面向语言模型适配的表示对齐辅助监督
translated_abstract: 语言模型展现出强大的推理能力，然而将它们适配到结构化领域仍然充满挑战，并且可能产生不一致的结果。我们识别出表示兼容性——即模型有效处理结构化任务中某种表示的程度——是适配过程中的关键因素。我们在国际象棋中研究这一问题，国际象棋提供了一个受控的测试平台，具有精确的语义、可计算的最优动作以及多种状态表示，包括符号编码（FEN）和空间格式（ASCII）。我们发现，模型对语义等价输入的处理方式往往存在显著差异，这会影响学习效果和泛化能力。基于这一观察，我们提出了表示对齐的辅助监督方法，该方法利用以兼容表示形式表达的环境衍生任务来改善语言模型对结构化领域的适配。在多种模型和表示上，辅助监督一致地提升了适配效果。
tldr: 提出表示对齐辅助监督方法，通过将环境衍生任务以兼容的表示形式作为辅助监督信号，持续提升语言模型向结构化领域（如国际象棋）的适配能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes representation-aligned auxiliary supervision, which uses environment-derived tasks expressed in compatible representations to consistently improve language model adaptation to structured domains such as chess.
